name: Recover no-show fees with a polite escalation ladder

parameters.content:
## Recover no-show fees with a polite escalation ladder and reply triage

### How it works
Two arms share one piece of state, so the ladder stops the moment a customer pays. The escalation arm runs every 12 hours, reads your no-show log and picks visits missed 20 to 30 hours ago, when a friendly invoice still feels fair. First-time no-shows get a short fee message with a payment link; repeat no-shows get the fee plus a deposit request. A send log in workflow static data keeps each tier to one message per appointment, and rows the reply arm already closed are skipped. The reply arm receives the customer's answer on a webhook: PAID or BETAALD marks the fee recovered, PARTIAL or DEEL logs a part payment and flags staff, DISPUTE or BETWIST freezes the case as a staff task, and anything else gets short keyword help. Replies without an appointment id or text are rejected with a 422.

### Setup steps
- Disable the demo node and connect your no-show sheet; required columns are listed in that node.
- Replace the placeholder send node with WhatsApp Business Cloud or SMS.
- Put your payment link where the messages say PAYMENTLINK.
- Route inbound replies to the payment-reply webhook (body: appointment_id, text).
- Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
- A sheet with one row per no-show: missed_at, fee_eur, prior_no_shows, phone, customer_name.
- A messaging provider that can forward inbound replies to a webhook.

### Customization
Keyword lists sit at the top of the classify node. Change the escalation threshold (currently 2 prior no-shows), the 20-30 hour window, the fee amounts, or the message copy per tier.

## 1. Read + validate
Every 12 hours. Demo source stands in for your sheet; a code node parses timestamps and an IF gate routes broken rows to an error log.

## 2. Window + escalate
Only visits missed 20-30h ago are due. First offense gets a friendly invoice; repeats get fee plus a deposit ask. Not-due rows skip silently.

## 3. Send + track
Placeholder send node, then a recovery tracker you can wire to a sheet.

## Reply webhook

### How it works
The gate rejects replies without an appointment id or text (422). One bilingual keyword maps to a verdict: PAID, BETAALD; PARTIAL, DEEL, GEDEELTELIJK; DISPUTE, BETWIST.

### Setup steps
- Route WhatsApp or SMS replies here with appointment_id and text.

## Verdict routing

### How it works
Paid or partial closes the case and stops the ladder; partial also flags staff. Dispute freezes the case as a staff task. Every verdict answers the webhook once.

### Setup steps
- Wire staff-flag rows to a Sheet or channel.
